## 简体中文

### 新增

- 项目网站新增自动中英文切换，并加入 ChatGPT、访达和 Visual Studio Code 的真实任务栏悬停预览示例。

### 性能

- 将 Alt-Tab 激活监听和辅助功能查询移出主线程；切换选中项时不再重建网格，并隔离快速切换会话。
- 在显示 Alt-Tab 前完成亚克力背景渲染，避免打开过程中材质发生可见变化。

### 修复

- 聚焦窗口监听器挂载后立即校准任务栏预留空间，让启动 WinTaskbar 时或应用变为活跃时已经最大化的窗口立刻避开任务栏。
- 点击 Alt-Tab 外部时仅关闭面板，不再激活当前选中的窗口；同时让网站任务栏与悬停预览和真实应用保持一致。

## English

### Added

- Added automatic English and Chinese localization to the project website, with real taskbar hover-preview examples for ChatGPT, Finder, and Visual Studio Code.

### Performance

- Kept Alt-Tab activation observation and Accessibility queries off the main thread, updated selection without rebuilding the grid, and isolated rapid switch sessions.
- Rendered the acrylic backdrop before presenting Alt-Tab to avoid visible material changes during opening.

### Fixed

- Reconciled taskbar space as soon as a focused-window observer attaches, so windows already maximized when WinTaskbar launches or when an application becomes active immediately avoid the taskbar.
- Prevented outside-click dismissal from activating a selected Alt-Tab window, and aligned the website taskbar and hover previews with the real application.
